subject: Acme Fintech Redwood pilot & procurement next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme-fintech.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Acme Fintech Redwood pilot & procurement next steps

Hi Samantha (and team),

Thanks again for taking the call earlier great to learn more about the ML infra and fraud workflows you're evaluating. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Pilot scope: 1 month trial (up to 1M tokens/day) of Redwood Hosted API for model serving + cost/latency dashboard.
- Key success criteria (from today's call):
  - 95th percentile latency under 250ms for 1k payloads
  - Unit cost <$0.002/token for production-like batch
  - Integration with your existing auth (API keys) and no customer data retention beyond session TTL
- Stakeholder mapping: could you confirm the economic buyer & procurement/legal contacts we should loop in? You mentioned product leadership would sign off.
- Procurement / onboarding asks from our side: typical items we see W-9, vendor form, PO details (billing address, remit, PO cadence), and any specific contract redlines your legal team prefers.

I've attached a draft SOW (Redwood_SOW_Draft_v1.pdf) to accelerate the procurement thread; it's intentionally light on T&Cs so we can iterate with your legal/procurement teams.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) You confirm the procurement/legal/economic buyer contacts and timeline for PO.
2) We share completed W-9 and final SOW once we align on billing details.
3) If convenient, we'll schedule a 30-min call next week to walk the SOW and acceptance criteria with procurement and legal.

Thanks looking forward to moving this over the finish line.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
T: 415-555-0132

Attachment: Redwood_SOW_Draft_v1.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme-fintech.com>

Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 09:10:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Acme Fintech Redwood pilot & procurement next steps

Thanks Marissa good recap.

Quick answers from our side:
- Economic buyer: Tom Reyes (CPO) — I've cc'd him here. He wants to see pilot metrics and a short ROI note.
- Procurement contact: procurement@acme-fintech.com (they handle POs and vendor setup)
- Legal: legal@acme-fintech.com (they will handle standard T&C review)
- Decision criteria: latency, integration effort, and predictable unit economics. Tom will sign off if the pilot shows results and there are no major legal blockers.
- Timeline: we are targeting a PO in early March. Procurement said vendor onboarding normally takes ~2 weeks once they have completed vendor paperwork and W-9.

I'll get procurement looped on the SOW and ask for their vendor onboarding checklist. If you can send W-9 and billing address now, that will speed things up.

Best,
Samantha Lee
Product Lead, Fraud Platform | Acme Fintech
samantha.lee@acme-fintech.com

Hi Marissa / Samantha,

Thanks for the SOW. To start vendor onboarding we need the following completed items: 
1) Completed vendor onboarding form (link below)
2) Current W-9 for Redwood Inference
3) Signed SOW or a note confirming pilot scope/term
4) Billing remit information (address + AP contact for invoicing)

Vendor portal: https://acme-fintech.vendor-portal.com/forms/vendor-onboarding
DocuSign (T&C review if needed): https://na1.docusign.net/DocuSign/#!/somedocusignlink

Our standard payment terms are Net30. Please provide a sample invoice that includes your billing address and tax information so we can create a vendor record. Once we receive items 1-3, we generally issue a PO within ~7 business days. If there are legal redlines, that may add time.

Let me know if Redwood needs any additional vendor forms (W-9 or W-8) we can accept via portal upload or email.

Thanks,
Acme Procurement
procurement@acme-fintech.com
